title: Identity change warning
summary: A bar above the composer of a DM or a group when a member's crypto identity changed (bipe#770): the person reset their identity (new recovery, new phone without the old one), or a verified person is no longer verified. This is the signal for an account takeover or a man in the middle. The Bipe profile facts (trust-facts, ADR 0074) are a different thing: they come from bipe-api, not from the crypto identity.

kind.description: changed: IdentityState pinViolation, text bipe_identity_change_body. verificationLost: IdentityState verificationViolation, text bipe_identity_change_verified_body.

warnings.description: From Room.subscribeToIdentityStatusChanges. A change to verified or pinned removes the person. The bar shows the first warning; with more, bipe_identity_change_more with the count of the others.

blocksSending.description: true while a warning has kind verificationLost: the composer is disabled until the person taps bipe_identity_change_ok.

acknowledge.effect: bipe_identity_change_ok on the bar: for the first warning, Encryption.userIdentity(userId, fallbackToServer: true), then UserIdentity.pin() for changed, UserIdentity.withdrawVerification() for verificationLost. The SDK then reports pinned and the warning goes. A failure shows bipe_error_generic and keeps the bar.

learnMore.effect: bipe_identity_change_learn_more: a dialog with bipe_identity_change_help and bipe_action_continue.

sendAnyway.effect: On an own message whose send failed with QueueWedgeError identityViolations or insecureDevices, the menu action retry is titled bipe_identity_change_send_anyway. identityViolations: Room.withdrawVerificationAndResend(users, sendHandle). insecureDevices: Room.ignoreDeviceTrustAndResend(userDeviceMap, sendHandle). Any other failure keeps retry with SendHandle.tryResend.

notes: The bar is above the composer, under the other bars of chat-timeline (profileNotice, theft mark), in DMs and in groups.
Plain words: the first line says the account security changed. It never says keys or cryptography.
Default chosen (bipe#770): no line in the timeline at the change, because the SDK reports the state, not an event at a place in the history. mz can overrule.
Default chosen (bipe#770): the link to the theft mark and guardian signals (ADR 0044) and a money pause for 24 h after a change are follow-ups, because they need bipe-api signals. mz can overrule.
